questions.text: Immigration Exemption Order (IEO) allows persons accredited as diplomats, consular representatives or visiting forces, and their dependants to apply to stay and work in Singapore under the Immigration Act.

questions.title: After making payment, how do I print my receipt?
questions.text:
Once payment is successful, there will be a pop-up window of the receipt. You can use the print function on the web browser to print the receipt.
You will not be able to reprint your receipt once you have closed the pop-up window of the receipt. If you require a receipt, please remember to print or save the receipt before closing the pop-up window.
Please refer to the ICA website for more information on payment-related enquiries.

questions.title: Can I make multiple transactions on MyICA, for e.g. applying for Passport and Identity Card?
questions.text: You can make multiple transactions on MyICA with a single sign-on using your Singpass.

questions.title: Can I save the application as draft and complete the application at another time?
questions.text:
A maximum of 7 applications can be saved as draft and they will be automatically deleted after 7 days from the last date it was saved. Currently, the feature is available for the following e-Services:
i. Visa application
ii. Long-Term Visit Pass application
More details will be shared when this feature is available for other e-Services.

questions.title: Can I set reminder alert in MyICA for the appointment/collection of the documents?
questions.text: The reminder alert using the calendar function in the mobile device is currently not available in MyICA. You will receive a message on the upcoming appointment under 'Notifications’ in MyICA after you have successfully made an appointment online.

questions.title: How do I book/ change/ cancel my appointment in MyICA?
questions.text: You will be prompted to make an appointment in 'Applications' if required. If you have booked an appointment, you will see your upcoming appointment in 'Notifications'. You can click on the notification to view instructions on how to make changes to the appointment. Alternatively, you can book, change or cancel an appointment in 'e-Services', under 'e-Appointment'.

questions.title: How do I change my name and registered address under ‘My Profile’ in MyICA?
questions.text:
You can click on the relevant links below for information to update your name and registered address with ICA.
Identity Card holders
Immigration Pass holders
Change of particulars in Identity Card
Change of residential address
Change of residential address (Long-Term Visit Pass)
Change of address (Student’s Pass)
For holders of passes issued by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), please contact MOM to update your name and/or registered address.

questions.title: How do I check my registered address?
questions.text: You may log in to MyICA and click on "MyProfile" from the "MyICA" drop-down list at the top right corner to view your personal details.

questions.title: How do I print or save the acknowledgement page?
questions.text: Once payment is successful, you will be brought back to an acknowledgement page. You can use the "Print" or "Save as PDF" function on the web browser to print or save a copy of the acknowledgement page.

questions.title: Is there any change to the processing time for applications submitted via MyICA?
questions.text: The processing time for the application(s) of the respective immigration facilities remains unchanged.

questions.title: Is there any fee for accessing the information in ‘MyTransaction’?
questions.text: There are no charges for accessing the information in 'MyTransaction' via MyICA e-Service.

questions.title: What are the benefits of using MyICA?
questions.text:
MyICA serves as your single access point to ICA's range of e-Services. Through this portal, you can:
Access personalised e-Services based on your residency/ immigration status
Make multiple transactions and payments in one session
Track your application status
Manage your ICA appointments
Receive notifications for upcoming appointments and document expiry reminders (e.g., passport)

questions.title: What are the e-Services available in MyICA?
questions.text:
The following e-Services are accessible via MyICA:
Application for passport & report loss of passport
Registration/ Re-registration/ Updating/ Report the loss of identity card, replace damaged identity card
Apply for change of residential address & re-print current address stickers (applicable to IC holders only)
Application for Singapore Citizenship/ Permanent Residence/ Long-Term Visit Pass/ Long-Term Visit Pass Renewal
Application/ Search for birth or death extract
Application for APEC Business Travel Card
Submission/ Retrieval/ Enquire assessment status for Pre-Marriage LTVP Assessment
Application/ Enquire status for Entry Visa
Submit new/ renewal applications for Re-entry Permit
Application status enquiries for the mentioned e-Services

questions.title: What are the supported browsers for MyICA?
questions.text: The supported browsers for MyICA are the latest two releases of Google Chrome, FireFox, Edge, and Safari.

questions.title: What does ‘Ref’ indicated under ‘Applications’ in MyICA stand for?
questions.text: ‘Ref’ indicated under ‘Applications’ in MyICA stands for the ‘reference number’ which is tagged to each application. You may require the reference number when making an appointment or status enquiry.

questions.title: What is 'MyCart' in MyICA drop-down menu?
questions.text: 'MyCart' displays a summary of the applications made (that require payment). You have the flexibility to unselect the transactions that you do not want to pay at that point in time. Transactions that have been unselected will continue to be available in 'MyCart' but will be removed after you log out of MyICA.

questions.title: What is 'MyDocuments'?
questions.text:
'MyDocuments' is a repository where you can retrieve your ICA-issued documents. For example, digital Long-Term Passes issued by ICA are available via 'MyDocuments' since 27 February 2023.
You can also access other government-issued documents through FileSG using the 'View Documents' link in the widget.

questions.title: What is MyICA?
questions.text: MyICA is a personalised portal for you to access ICA's range of electronic services (e-Services) and personal information on a single secure digital platform.

questions.title: What is ‘Advisories’ in MyICA?
questions.text: ‘Advisories’ in MyICA provides information such as travel advisories which may be useful to you.

questions.title: What is ‘Applications’ in MyICA?
questions.text: ‘Applications’ in MyICA displays your current application(s) and status. It may also inform you of the next steps to take.

questions.title: What is ‘e-Services’ in MyICA?
questions.text: 'e-Services’ in MyICA displays the e-Services currently available in MyICA that are relevant to your residency or immigration status. If you cannot find a specific service in the widget, you can use the 'search' button located at the top right of the MyICA dashboard.

questions.title: What is ‘MyProfile’ in MyICA?
questions.text: 'MyProfile' is a personalised profile page at MyICA that allows you to view your up-to-date personal information such as your registered address, email address and mobile number.

questions.title: What is ‘Notifications’ in MyICA?
questions.text: ‘Notifications’ in MyICA allows you to receive messages relevant to you. This includes the expiry of your documents such as your passport, re-registration of your identity card and your upcoming appointments with ICA.

questions.title: Where can I find a guide for MyICA?
questions.text: When you log in to MyICA using your Singpass for the first time, you will be offered to learn about the features of MyICA. You may click on the '► Learn' button on your MyICA Home to replay the tour.

questions.title: Who is eligible to use MyICA?
questions.text: You will be able to log into MyICA if you have a valid Singpass. However, some e-Services are only available to Singapore Citizens and/ or Permanent Residents.

questions.title: Will e-Services that do not require Singpass login still be available?
questions.text: e-Services that do not require Singpass will continue to be available on the ICA website.

questions.title: Will I be able to make a single appointment to collect all documents (e.g. passport, identity card)?
questions.text:
Separate appointments will need to be made to collect the different documents.
Note: Eligible applicants who have re-registered for an identity card when they apply for a passport can collect both passport and identity card in a single appointment.

questions.title: Will I be logged out of MyICA when I navigate to other links such as ICA website?
questions.text: You will not be automatically logged out of MyICA when you navigate to other links in the ICA website. However, you will be alerted to extend your login session if your session in MyICA is expiring.

questions.title: Will I need to make separate payments for multiple transactions on MyICA?
questions.text: You can make payment for multiple transactions. A feature in MyICA called MyCart, displays a summary of the transactions made that require payment. You have the flexibility to unselect the transactions that you do not want to pay at that point in time. Transactions that have been unselected will continue to be available in MyCart until you log out.

questions.title: Will MyInfo be available on MyICA?
questions.text: e-Services that are available in MyICA will be linked to MyInfo to pre-fill the personal data fields, where applicable.

questions.title: Can I take a selfie with my mobile phone for my passport or identity card (IC) application?
questions.text: Please do not take a selfie from your mobile phone as the photo image will be flipped. Please ask someone to help you with the photo-taking if you are using your mobile phone camera.

questions.title: Can I use a photograph taken with my mobile phone for a passport or identity card (IC) application?
questions.text: We recommend that you download and use mobile apps that are specifically designed to take photographs for Singapore passport or identity card applications. These apps usually come with features that will help you take photographs in the required dimensions. Some suggested search-words you can use on the Android Play Store or Apple App Store are 'Singapore Passport’, 'Singapore IC’ and 'Photo’. The photograph will be accepted if it complies with our photo guidelines.

questions.title: Can I use the same photo for my IC and passport applications?
questions.text: You may use the same photo if the photo is taken within 3 months from the date of application.

questions.title: Can I cancel the Letter of Eligibility issued after the approval of the PMLA?
questions.text: The Letter of LTVP Eligibility is not an immigration pass. It is valid for 1 year and will lapse upon the expiry of its validity. There is no need to submit any cancellation or withdrawal request.

questions.title: Can I submit another PMLA if I receive an unsuccessful outcome?
questions.text: You do not need to submit a new PMLA unless there are updated information or changes to the circumstances since your last PMLA submission.

questions.title: Can I submit another PMLA if my current submission is still pending an outcome?
questions.text:
You are not allowed to submit another PMLA if you have not receive the outcome of your current submission.
However, if there is wrong information submitted and you wish to update the new information, please visit the ICA e-Service's Dashboard and re-submit a new PMLA.

questions.title: How do I obtain the Letter of LTVP Eligibility?
questions.text:
Those who are assessed by ICA to be eligible for LTVP, based on the information submitted in your PMLA, will be issued a Letter of LTVP Eligibility which is valid for 1 year.
You may retrieve your Letter of Eligibility via ICA e-Service's Dashboard. Alternatively, you may login to MyICA to enquire the status of your PMLA.

questions.title: Will I be notified of the outcome of my PMLA application?
questions.text:
The outcome notification will be sent to the email address which you have provided in the PMLA. You may wish to check your spam or junk inbox in case the email notification was directed to your spam or junk inbox.
You are also advised to check your outcome status using the ICA e-Service's Dashboard. Alternatively, you may login to MyICA to enquire the status of your PMLA.

questions.title: What information can be found in e-Pass?
questions.text:
The e-Pass contains details of the visit pass granted, including the maximum number of day(s) of stay granted and the last day of stay allowed in Singapore.
Foreign visitors can retrieve the e-Pass issued to them via the e-Pass Enquiry Portal after entering Singapore. The portal is accessible via the SG Arrival Card e-Service or via the direct URL: https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/sgarrivalcard/epassenquiry.
Foreign visitors are reminded that remaining in Singapore beyond the date (of the last day of stay allowed) without a valid visit pass or any other valid immigration facility is an offence under Immigration Act 1959. Foreign visitors who need to stay beyond the visit pass granted to them should visit the ICA website to apply to extend their visit pass.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)

questions.title: What should I do if I did not receive my electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) after I enter Singapore?
questions.text:
Upon being granted entry into Singapore, the e-Pass will be automatically issued to foreign visitors via email based on the email address declared in the SG Arrival Card submission. Foreign visitors may also check their email spam/ junk folder if they are unable to find the e-Pass in their email inbox.
Foreign visitors may also retrieve the e-Pass issued to them via the e-Pass Enquiry Portal. The portal is accessible via the SG Arrival Card e-Service or via the direct URL: https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/sgarrivalcard/epassenquiry.
Foreign visitors will need to key in their Disembarkation/ Embarkation (DE) number, or passport details to retrieve their e-Pass. The DE number is provided to foreign visitors after submitting their SG Arrival Card prior to arrival immigration clearance.
You may submit your enquiry should you require further assistance on your DE number or e-Pass retrieval.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)

questions.title: Who can I approach for assistance if I encounter problem when retrieving my e-Pass via portal?
questions.text:
Foreign visitors can retrieve the e-Pass issued to them via the e-Pass Enquiry Portal.
If you encounter any problems with the e-Pass Enquiry Portal, you may submit your enquiry with a screenshot of the error message (if available).
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)

questions.title: Why is there no arrival endorsement in my passport after I enter Singapore as a foreign visitor?
questions.text:
ICA has replaced the arrival stamp endorsements issued to foreign visitors on short-term visit pass with the electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass).
Upon being granted entry into Singapore, the e-Pass will be automatically issued to foreign visitors via email based on the email address declared in their SG Arrival Card submission. Foreign visitors may also check their email spam/ junk folder if they are unable to find the e-Pass in their email inbox.
You may refer to ICA website for more information on entering Singapore.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)

questions.title: Are there issues if I did not submit the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) before arriving to Singapore?
questions.text: Travellers are strongly encouraged to submit their SG Arrival Card before arriving in Singapore, as those who have not done so will be required to submit on arrival before they can proceed for immigration clearance. This will delay their immigration clearance unnecessarily.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Can I download the updated copy of the SG Arrival Card (SGAC)?
questions.text:
If you are using the SG Arrival Card e-Service, you may download a PDF copy of the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) upon updating your SGAC record.
If you are using the MyICA Mobile App, you may view the updated SGAC record under 'Individual Submission' or 'Group Submission' section found under the mobile app SGAC module at any time.
Please be informed that all updated SG Arrival Card information will be stored in ICA's system.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Can I make changes to the trip details for one of my group members if they are not the same?
questions.text:
You can choose to amend the trip details of any member in the group if he/ she has an itinerary different from the 'lead traveller' or 'leader'. If you are using the SG Arrival Card e-Service, you can uncheck the box 'Same as Lead Traveller'.
Please make sure that the information you are submitting on behalf of your group is true and accurate.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Can I submit SG Arrival Card for multiple trips at one go?
questions.text: You can submit up to three trips per individual submission. For the mobile application, simply select the 'Add Trip' or '+' button at the 'Declaration Summary' page to fill in your subsequent trip details.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Can I submit SG Arrival Card on behalf of someone?
questions.text:
You may submit the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) on behalf of others. Please ensure that the information you have submitted on behalf of others is true and accurate.
For travellers who require assistance to submit the SGAC, you may get someone else (i.e. your proxy) to submit the SGAC on your behalf prior to your arrival in Singapore.
Your proxy must ensure that the information submitted on your behalf is true and accurate.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Can I submit the SG Arrival Card if I do not have an email address?
questions.text:
You are required to provide a valid email address and contact number when submitting the SG Arrival Card with health declaration. Without a valid email address, you will not receive the acknowledgement email and will experience delay during immigration clearance.
You are encouraged to create an email address prior to the submission of your SG Arrival Card with health declaration.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Can I use the “Copy” function to duplicate information from my previous trip to my upcoming trip?
questions.text: You may use the 'Copy' function from your previous trip record and edit your upcoming trip details. Please note that this function is only applicable for MyICA Mobile App.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: How can I update my information if there are changes to the submitted details on SG Arrival Card (SGAC)?
questions.text:
You can update your arrival information in the SG Arrrival Card e-service via 'Update a Submission', provided the record has not expired. Please note that the arrival information you have submitted for each trip will expire:-
i) after the date of arrival; or
ii) after you have made your trip, whichever is earlier.
If you are using MyICA Mobile App, you can update your arrival information, provided the record has not expired, by navigating to your trip record and select the 'Edit' button to make the changes. You can tap on the 'Submit' button after making the amendments.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: How do I cancel or delete my earlier SG Arrival Card (SGAC) if I submit a new SGAC?
questions.text: You are not required to cancel or delete your declarations. If there is any change to your earlier submitted SG Arrival Card, you will need to resubmit a new SG Arrival Card with the updated information. The earlier submission will be superseded by the new declaration.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: How do I proceed with the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) submission if my nationality is not in the Nationality/Citizenship dropdown list?
questions.text: You may select ”Others” from the Nationality/ Citizenship dropdown list to proceed with your SG Arrival Card submission.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: How do I submit the SG Arrival Card (SGAC)?
questions.text:
You may submit your SG Arrival Card via the SG Arrival Card e-Service or via the 'MyICA’ mobile application. The mobile application can be downloaded for free from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android).
You can refer to SG Arrival Card for more information.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: What features does the SG Arrival Card have?
questions.text:
The following features are available in the SG Arrival Card:-
Individual Submission
Group submission: Travellers arriving to Singapore in small groups can make a 1-time group submission for up to a maximum of 10 people in a submission. Trip information such as flight details, last port of embarkation, expected date of arrival and departure, as well as address in Singapore will be automatically replicated for all persons in the group. Please make sure that the information you are submitting on behalf of your group is true and accurate.
Update submission: Travellers can also update their SG Arrival Card information, provided the record has not expired.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: What is the validity of the SG Arrival Card (SGAC)?
questions.text:
You need to submit an SG Arrival Card for each trip to Singapore.
The SG Arrival Card submitted for each trip expires:-
i) after the date of the arrival, or
ii) after you have made your trip, whichever is earlier.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: What should I input for "Vehicle Number" if I do not have the transport details before arrival or at arrival?
questions.text:
Travelling to Singapore by Bus
You may wish to submit your declaration on the same day of your arrival when you have the vehicle number. Alternatively, you may submit the declaration beforehand and indicate 'BUS' under Vehicle Number.
When the vehicle number is available, you may update your declaration via:
a) the SG Arrival Card e-Service under "Update a Submission"; or
b) MyICA Mobile App: Select the submitted SG Arrival Card record and tap on the "Edit" button
Travelling to Singapore by Rail
If you are travelling by rail, you may wish to submit your declaration on the same day of your arrival when you have the vehicle number. Alternatively, you may submit the declaration beforehand and indicate 'TRAIN' under Vehicle Number.
When the train number is available, you may update your declaration via:
a) the SG Arrival Card e-Service under "Update a Submission"; or
b) ICA Mobile App: Select the submitted SG Arrival Card record and tap on the "Edit" button.
Travelling to Singapore by Foot
If you are travelling by foot, you may select mode of travel as 'BUS' and indicate 'NA' under Vehicle Number.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: What should I key in for the field 'Date of Departure from Singapore' if I am not leaving Singapore?
questions.text:
You are expected to provide information that is true, accurate, and complete to the best of your knowledge and belief.
If you are a short-term visitor, you must be able to provide a confirmed onward or return ticket (where applicable) to be considered for entry to Singapore. Please refer to ICA's entry requirements for more information.
If you are an In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter holder, you may provide an indicative departure date that is 30 days from the arrival date and the same city as the last city/port of embarkation in your SG Arrival Card, if you do not have the information at the point of submission.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: What should I select for SG Arrival Card (SGAC) if I have an In-Principle Approval (IPA) issued by MOM or ICA?
questions.text: A holder of an In-Principle Approval (IPA) issued by ICA/ MOM will need to submit the arrival information and the health declaration as a foreign visitor via the SG Arrival Card e-Service.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: What will happen if a traveller submits a false declaration?
questions.text:
Travellers who provide false declarations will be liable for prosecution under the Immigration Act or Infectious Diseases Act.
Travellers must update and re-submit their declarations if there is any change to their health status or travel history before arriving in Singapore.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: When should I submit or apply for the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) with Electronic Health Declaration?
questions.text:
Arriving travellers can submit their personal information, trip details and health declaration through the SG Arrival Card e-Service at the ICA website or via MyICA mobile app within 3 days prior to the date of their arrival in Singapore.
For example, travellers arriving in Singapore on 30 June 2025 can only submit their declaration from 28 June 2025 onwards.
This means that they will only need to produce their passports for immigration clearance upon arrival, as ICA's immigration system will already have the electronic arrival cards which they submitted in advance.
The above does not apply to those who are transiting or transferring through Singapore without seeking immigration clearance; or Singapore citizens, Permanent residents, and Long-Term Pass holders* entering via Land Checkpoints.
*Long-Term Pass holders include holders of Student's Pass, Dependant's Pass, Long-Term Visit Pass and Work Pass.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Why do I need to create a profile before I can submit my particulars and trip information?
questions.text: The creation of profile enables you to store your personal information. The information can be auto populated to your subsequent trip record without the need to fill in the same details again. Please note that this is only applicable for the MyICA Mobile App.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Why do I need to provide my contact information in SG Arrival Card?
questions.text:
An acknowledgement email will be sent to the email address you have provided upon successful submission of the SG Arrival Card. For foreign visitors, the electronic Pass (e-Pass) will be sent to you via email after immigration clearance.
Your contact information is necessary for contact tracing purposes in the event of pandemic situation.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: Why is it necessary for all arriving travellers to submit SG Arrival Card with health declaration?
questions.text: The electronic health declaration is in place for purposes of disease control, specifically to guard against importing diseases of concern, to protect the health of Singapore residents. Those who make false declarations may be prosecuted under the Infectious Diseases Act.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / General

questions.title: What should I do if I am prompted with an error message when submitting the SG Arrival Card?
questions.text:
For more information on the SG Arrival Card e-Service, please refer to our Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) and video guide.
You may also submit an enquiry with a screenshot of the error message (if available) for further clarification on your SGAC submission. Do indicate whether you are using the web service or MyICA Mobile App for the error encountered when submitting the SG Arrival Card application.
topics: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass)
SG Arrival Card (SGAC) and Electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) / Technical Assistance

questions.title: Can I submit another application online if my first application to extend my stay is unsuccessful?
questions.text:
Each application is assessed carefully based on its own merits. If there are changes in your circumstances or new grounds for consideration, you may submit another application.
Please ensure that all details provided in your application are accurate (e.g. DE number, passport number, Name, etc).
Overstaying is an immigration offence. Please make the necessary arrangements to depart Singapore if you are unable to extend your stay before the expiry of your short-term visit pass.

questions.title: How do I check the status of my application for extension of stay?
questions.text:
You can check the status of your application online via the 'Enquire Application Status' function in the e-Service by keying in your travel document number and DE number (found in the SG Arrival Card acknowledgement), or your travel document number and expiry date.
Your application for the extension of your [short-term visit pass will be processed within 5 working days (excluding Public Holidays and weekends). Some applications may take longer to process.

questions.title: How do I extend my Short-Term Visit Pass (STVP) or stay in Singapore?
questions.text:
All Short-Term Visit Pass (STVP) extension applications must be submitted online via the e-Service. Walk-in applications will not be accepted. You are advised to submit your application when your STVP has a remaining validity of 14 days or less. Your application will be processed within 5 working days (excluding Public Holidays and weekends). Some applications may take longer to process.
Overstaying is an immigration offence. Please make the necessary arrangements to depart Singapore if you are unable to extend your stay before the expiry of your short-term visit pass.

questions.title: How do I extend my stay if I am unable to submit the application online?
questions.text:
All Short-Term Visit Pass (STVP) extension applications must be submitted online via the e-Service.
If you are unable to submit the STVP extension application online, you may contact us via the enquiry form with a screenshot of the error, along with the particulars of the applicant, applicant’s travel document and contact information so that we may contact you for further clarification.

questions.title: How do I extend my short-term visit pass or special pass issued by MOM after my work pass or dependant's pass cancellation?
questions.text:
ICA is unable to extend the short-term visit pass or special pass granted by MOM upon the cancellation of your Personalised Employment Pass, Work Permit, S Pass, Employment Pass or Dependant’s Pass. Please inform your ex-employer to apply for your extension of stay online with MOM at www.mom.gov.sg/extend-stay.
Alternatively, you may wish to email MOM at mom_wpd@mom.gov.sg or contact them at 64385122.

questions.title: How do I know if I need to make any payment for my extension of stay application?
How do I retrieve my DE number to complete my extension of stay application?
questions.text: You can enquire your DE number at the e-Pass Enquiry Portal using your passport details.

questions.title: How do I withdraw the application for extension of visit pass?
questions.text:
You may contact us via the enquiry form and indicate the reason to withdraw the application for extension of visit pass, for e.g. the information of the applicant was entered wrongly.
Please note that you will not be able to withdraw the application once an outcome has been granted to the application.

questions.title: How should I appeal if my extension of stay application is unsuccessful?
questions.text:
If your application is unsuccessful, you may submit a new application via the e-Service, citing the reasons for the request. Please ensure that all details provided in your application are accurate (e.g. DE number, Name, etc).
Overstaying is an immigration offence. Please make the necessary arrangements to depart Singapore if you are unable to extend your stay before the expiry of your short-term visit pass.

questions.title: What can I do if the e-Service hangs when I enter my details for the extension of stay application?
questions.text:
You can refresh your browser and submit or resubmit the application.
You can check your application status via the 'Enquire Application Status' function of the e-Service by keying in your travel document and DE number; or travel document number and travel document expiry date.

questions.title: What should I do if I encounter error messages when submitting my extension of stay application?
What should I do if I fail to pay the necessary fees for the extension of stay application on time?
questions.text:
Your application to extend your stay will be withdrawn if payment is not made within the time frame as indicated on the In-Principle Approval notice.
If your application in withdrawn, you will need to submit a fresh application online via the e-Service. Otherwise, you are advised to depart on or before the expiry date of your existing short-term visit pass. You are reminded to monitor your application status online and make the payment promptly within the specified time frame once you received the In-Principle Approval notice.

questions.title: When do I need to submit the requested documents when applying for extension of stay?
questions.text: You are required to monitor the status of your application and submit the required documents online within the specified timeframe. The application will be withdrawn if the original documents are not submitted to ICA within the specified time frame.

questions.title: When should I make payment for my extension of stay application?
questions.text: Payment must be made within the time frame indicated on the In-Principle Approval notice, otherwise the application will be treated as withdrawn.

questions.title: How can I cancel a Short-Term Visit Pass?
questions.text: The Short-Term Visit Pass (STVP) will automatically expire after the last day of validity or when the traveller departs Singapore. There is no need to cancel the STVP if a traveller wishes to depart Singapore before the expiry.

questions.title: How do I prove my extension of stay is valid if I am checked by the authorities?
questions.text:
You are advised to print out the approval slip using the 'Enquire Application Status' function in the e-Service and place it in your passport for easy reference.
Foreign visitors could either be holding a travel document with a physical endorsement of the short-term visit pass (STVP); an electronic visit pass (e-Pass) or a printed approval slip to indicate the new extended STVP.
If the application for extension of stay was made online, you can verify the stay validity by using the 'Enquire Application Status' function in the e-Service. You will need to key in either the travel document number and DE number (found in the SG Arrival Card acknowledgement); or the travel document number and its expiry date.

questions.title: How do I update my address with ICA if I am a short-term visit pass (STVP) holder?
questions.text: You are not required to update your address with ICA if you are a short-term vist pass (STVP) holder. However, you may update your current address when you submit the online application for extension of stay should you wish to extend your stay in Singapore.

questions.title: What are the available payment modes for an extension of stay application?
questions.text:
The payment must be made via:
VISA
MasterCard Credit/Debit
American Express (AMEX) card
Internet banking (DBS/POSB, OCBC, UOB and Standard Chartered Bank banking account in Singapore)
PayNow
The following cards are not accepted:
JCB cards
Any other types of credit/charge cards
Please refer to the ICA website for more information on payment-related enquiries.

questions.title: What are the fees to extend my stay for social visit or to seek medical treatment?
questions.text:
Visitors who require a longer stay beyond the visit pass validity which was issued to them upon entry into Singapore for social visit or to seek medical treatment, may submit an application for extension of stay using the e-Service.
The applicable fees upon approval may include:
• S$40 per extension
• S$30 per visa

questions.title: What if I lose the approval slip for my short-term visit pass (STVP) extension and SG Arrival Card?
questions.text:
You can retrieve your approval slip using the 'Enquire Application Status' function in the e-Service by keying in your travel document number and DE number (found in the SG Arrival Card acknowledgement); or travel document number and expiry date.
Please be assured that an immigration officer can verify the validity of your STVP even if you do not have the approval slip and/or SG Arrival Card at the point of departure.

questions.title: How do I extend the Special Pass of my newborn if the foreign passport is not ready for collection?
questions.text:
Every foreign newborn in Singapore is automatically issued with a Special Pass at birth, valid for 42 days from birth. If you are unable to obtain a travel document for your child within the stipulated timeframe, please report at least 7 working days prior to the 42nd day of your child's birth for the renewal of your child's Special Pass at the following offices during office hours:
a) Submit the extension of stay form at least 7 days before the expiry of your child’s current Special Pass (if you are a Visit Pass holder or a Permanent Resident of Singapore)
b) Ministry of Manpower Services Centre, 1500 Bendemeer Road, Hall B - by appointment only (if you hold a valid work pass with dependant privileges)
Please bring along the following documents before calling at either of the above-mentioned offices:
a) Both parents' travel documents and Identification Cards (for Permanent Residents) or work passes (for existing Work Pass holders)
b) Parents' marriage certificate
c) Child's Birth Certificate
d) Advisory Note issued at birth
e) Letter of acknowledgement from your Embassy or High Commission in Singapore indicating that you have submitted an application for a travel document for your child.

questions.title: Am I eligible for a Student's Pass?
questions.text: If you are a foreigner seeking admission to an educational institution to pursue full-time studies in Singapore, you are required to apply for a Student's Pass (STP) following acceptance by an educational institution. Please submit a STP application to ICA for consideration after your acceptance.

questions.title: Can I apply for a Student's Pass while pending a Permanent Resident application?
questions.text: You may apply for a Student's Pass while pending the outcome of your permanent residence application. All applications will be processed and assessed on its own merits.

questions.title: Can I apply for Student's Pass If I am a S Pass holder?
questions.text: If you wish to pursue full-time studies in Singapore, you must first be accepted by an approved education institution to be eligible for application of a Student's Pass.

questions.title: I have been asked to nominate a new local sponsor for my Student's Pass (STP) application. How do I nominate a new local sponsor?
questions.text:
To nominate a new local sponsor, you are required to login to ICA e-service using the following steps:
1. Click on [GOV]
2. Click on [Student]
3. Key in the student particulars and click on [Login]
4. Click on [Re-nominate Local Sponsor] at the main menu
The new local sponsor is required to login to ICA e-service using the following steps:
1. Click on [Local Sponsor]
2. Click on [GOV]
3. Login using Singpass
4. Key in the Student's Pass Application No. and click on [Proceed]

questions.title: Do I need a local sponsor if I am applying for a Student's Pass?
questions.text:
You will need a local sponsor if you are applying for a Student's Pass to study in Government Schools (GOV) or in an Institute of Technical Education (ITE).
The local sponsor must be a Singapore citizen or Permanent Resident (PR) aged 21 or older. Companies and organisations cannot act as local sponsors.
If you have a Singapore citizen or PR parent or step-parent, he/ she must act as the local sponsor for your Student's Pass application.

questions.title: Do I need to apply for Student's Pass for my child to attend Preschool?
questions.text: Any foreigner seeking to study in Singapore should apply for a Student’s Pass, upon acceptance into an educational institution. If your foreign child is enrolled in an Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA)-licensed kindergarten or childcare centre, you may apply for a Student's Pass. You do not need to apply for a Student's pass to attend a kindergarten/childcare centre if you already have a Dependant's Pass, Long-Term Visit Pass or Immigration Exemption Order.

questions.title: Do I need to stay in Singapore while I apply for my Student's Pass?
questions.text: You do not need to stay in Singapore while your application is being processed.

questions.title: How can I appeal if my application for a Student's Pass is rejected?
questions.text: If your application is unsuccessful, you should inform your school before submitting an appeal to ICA. You may then submit an appeal via the enquiry form, along with your application reference number. Each appeal will be considered on its own merits. The general processing time for appeal cases is about 4 weeks and the outcome of the appeal will be made known to both you and the school.

questions.title: Can I change my local sponsor after I am issued with a valid Student's Pass?
questions.text:
If a Student's Pass holder wishes to change local sponsor whilst continuing his/ her studies, he/ she may find a new local sponsor who is a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident (PR) above the age of 21 years old. Companies or organisations are not allowed to act as local sponsors.
The new local sponsor has to login to ICA e-Service and refer to the following steps to sponsor the Student’s Pass application:
1. Click on [Local Sponsor]
2. Click on [GOV]
3. Login using the Singpass
4. Enter Student's Pass Application No. and click on [Proceed]
The processing time for change of local sponsor is approximately 1 to 2 weeks.

questions.title: How can I contact Student’s Pass unit?
questions.text: You may contact Student's Pass unit via the enquiry form.

questions.title: How can I get a copy of the In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter for Student's Pass?
questions.text:
Prospective students of Institute of Higher Learning can log in to the e-Service to retrieve a copy of the In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter for Student's Pass.
Prospective students of other education institutions or schools can retrieve a copy of the IPA letter for STP after selecting their school type and logging in to this e-Service.

questions.title: How can I print the application forms for Student’s Pass?
questions.text:
Prospective students of Institute of Higher Learning can log in to the e-Service to retrieve the application forms for Student's Pass (STP).
Prospective students of other education institutions or schools can retrieve the application forms for STP after selecting their school type and logging in to this e-Service.

questions.title: How can I submit my sponsor submission for Government schools or Institute of Technical Education?
questions.text:
You will need to be nominated as a Local Sponsor in the e-Service by the student in his Student's Pass application. Once you have been nominated as a Local Sponsor, you can:
1) Access the e-Service
2) Click on 'Local Sponsor' icon
3) Click on 'Government School (GOV)' or 'Institute of Technical Education (ITE)'
4) Login using your SingPass.
5) Enter Student's Pass Application Number or Student's FIN and Student's Pass Expiry Date and click 'Next' to be redirected to Local Sponsor main menu.

questions.title: How do I amend a Student's Pass application that has been submitted?
questions.text: Applicants will not be able to make further changes to the details submitted once the application is submitted successfully. You or your school will have to submit a new application with the correct details.

questions.title: How do I apply for Student's Pass (STP) online?
questions.text:
You must be accepted for admission into a full-time course by a recognised education institution in Singapore to apply for a Student's Pass (STP).
Your school will register you as a student in ICA's e-Service for a STP before you submit your application.
With the STP application number provided by the school, you will be able to login to ICA e-Service and apply for a STP by completing the application forms. Some applications may require a local sponsor.
The local sponsor, a Singapore citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident, will then login to the e-Service using his/ her SingPass to sponsor the STP application.
A non-refundable S$45 processing fee must be made through eNets Credit/ Debit or Internet Banking for Student's Pass applications submitted to ICA. Please refer to ICA website for more information on payment-related enquiries.
A. For prospective students of Institutes of Higher Learning, please click here.
B: For other prospective students, please click here.

questions.title: How do I apply for Student's Pass (STP) to study in an Institute of Higher Learning (IHL)?
questions.text:
You can login to the e-Service for Institutes for Higher Learning and do the following:
1) Click on "Foreign Student" button
2) On Student login page, enter the Student's Pass Application Number, Full Name (As appears in travel document), select 'Sex', 'Nationality/ Citizenship' and 'Date of Birth'
3) Click on "LOGIN" button
4) Click "Submit eform"

questions.title: How do I check the status of my Student's Pass application?
questions.text:
Prospective students of Institute of Higher Learning can log in to the e-Service to check the status of your Student's Pass (STP) application.
Prospective students of other education institutions or schools can check the status of your STP application after selecting the school type and logging in to this e-Service.

questions.title: How do I know which application type I need to submit (new, renew or transfer application)?
questions.text:
If you are an existing student who wishes to apply for a new Student's Pass in order to study in a different Private Education Institution, you have to submit an application for 'Student's Pass for Transfer School'.
If you are an existing student who wishes to continue to study in the same course in the same school, you should submit a renewal application. However, if the application is more than 3 months from the last valid Student's Pass, you will have to submit a 'New' Student's Pass application.

questions.title: How do I withdraw my Student's Pass application?
questions.text: You may withdraw the Student's Pass application through the Student's Pass e-Service. Alternatively, you may approach the school for the withdrawal of your application.

questions.title: How long does it take for my online application for a Student's Pass to be processed?
questions.text: The requirements, procedures and processing time for a Student's Pass differ slightly depending on the type of educational institution. You can refer to ICA Service Commitment for more information on the processing time for Student's Pass.

questions.title: Is my Student's Pass issued under my School?
questions.text: While you must be accepted for admission into a full-time course by a recognised education institution in Singapore to apply for a Student's Pass, your Student's Pass will be issued by ICA if you meet the requirements to study in the recognised education institution (that you have applied for).

questions.title: Is there a quota on the number of short courses I can attend in a year without a Student's Pass?
What can I do if I encounter system errors when submitting my Student’s Pass application online?
questions.text:
You may try clearing your internet browser's cache and re-submit the application.
If you are unable to submit your application even after clearing your cache, you can contact us via the enquiry form with a screenshot and description of the error.

questions.title: What should I do if my Student's Pass application is receiving attention still after the general processing time?
questions.text:
Please note that some applications may take longer to process. You may wish to check your Student’s Pass (STP) application status using the STP e-Service for the updated application status.
If the outcome of your application has yet to be updated in the Student's Pass e-Service, you may contact us via the enquiry form for assistance.

questions.title: What will happen if I do not pay the Student's Pass processing fees?
questions.text: If the Student's Pass processing fees are not paid, your application will not be submitted to the ICA for processing.

questions.title: Where can I find the list of schools for Institutes of Higher Learning?
questions.text: You may refer to the Institutes of Higher Learning (IHL) list.

questions.title: Why was my Student's Pass application rejected?
questions.text:
We regret to inform you that we are unable to share specific information on the assessment of applications. All Student's Pass applications are carefully considered and reviewed by ICA.
You may refer to Becoming a Student's Pass Holder for more information on Student's Pass requirements.

questions.title: Will my Student's Pass application be processed if my name in the application differs from passport?
questions.text: Your name on your application and passport must match. Your school will have to submit a new application.

questions.title: Will my Student's Pass application be processed?
questions.text: All Student's Pass applications will be processed and assessed on its own merits.

questions.title: Can I extend my Student's Pass In-Principle Approval?
questions.text: The Student's Pass In-Principle Approval (IPA) validity is stated on the letter and no extension of validity is allowed. If your Student's Pass IPA has expired before you can complete formalities, you will need to submit a new Student's Pass application.

questions.title: Do I have to be present physically during the Student's Pass completion of formalities?
questions.text: You are required to be present physically for your Student's Pass completion of formalities at ICA Services Centre.

questions.title: Do I have to cancel my Dependant's pass before Student's Pass is issued?
questions.text: Upon issuance of a Student's pass, your Dependant's Pass will be automatically cancelled.

questions.title: Do I have to cancel my Long-Term Visit Pass before Student's Pass is issued?
questions.text: Upon issuance of a Student's pass, the Long-Term Visit Pass will be automatically cancelled.

questions.title: Does my child require a medical report to complete formalities for Student's Pass?
questions.text: You may refer to your In-Principle Approval letter which will indicate whether your child is required to furnish any medical report for Student's Pass issuance.

questions.title: How do I complete formalities for my Student's Pass?
questions.text:
You may refer to your In-Principle-Approval letter for the requirements regarding the completion of formalities for your Student's Pass (STP).
You may also refer to ICA website for more information on the completion of formalities for your STP.
Please make an appointment at ICA e-Service for the completion of formalities for your STP. You are advised to book an earlier appointment date (if available) for the issuance of your Student's Pass before your class commences.

questions.title: What are the documents required to complete formalities for my Student's Pass?
questions.text: You may refer to your In-Principle Approval letter on the documents required for completion of formalities.

questions.title: What can I do if my visit pass expires before my appointment to complete Student's Pass formalities?
questions.text: You will need to apply for extension of stay online before the expiry of your visit pass.

questions.title: I am required to furnish a recent medical report to complete formalities for my Student's Pass. What do I do if I left my original laboratory report at my home country?
questions.text: A copy of the laboratory report must be attached to the medical examination report (only if the medical examination and testing is carried out overseas) and uploaded to the e-Service for the completion of formalities of the Student's Pass.

questions.title: What is the validity of my Student's Pass In-Principle Approval letter?
questions.text: You may refer to your In-Principle Approval letter on the validity of the letter.

questions.title: What should I do if my medical report is dated more than 3 months ago?
questions.text: You should re-take your medical examination and submit the new medical report.

questions.title: Are there any differences in the digital STP from FileSG, MyICA, MyICA Mobile and the Singpass app?
questions.text: The digital STPs found on FileSG, MyICA, MyICA Mobile and the Singpass app are official documents that are issued to legitimise a person's stay in Singapore.

questions.title: Can I receive and manage the digital Student's Pass (STP) on behalf of my family members?
questions.text:
Only the sponsor of STP holders below 15 years old will receive a copy of the STP in his/ her own FileSG account. This copy is only issued to sponsors who are Singpass holders.
Family members, who are not sponsors of STP holders, can still retrieve the digital STP via non-Singpass login on the FileSG website - by logging in with the credentials of the STP holder and by satisfying Two-Factor Authentication with the One-Time-Password that will be sent to the mobile number provided in the STP application.

questions.title: Can I request for a physical Student's Pass (STP) after 27 Feb 2023, in addition to the digital STP?
questions.text: ICA has ceased the issuance of physical Student's Pass (STP) cards from 27 Feb 2023. STP will henceforth be issued in digital format only.

questions.title: Can students provide the School's generic email address in the Student's Pass (STP) application?
questions.text: We strongly encourage students to create and provide their own email address in their STP application. The declared email address will receive an email notification on the issuance of digital STP and will contain a unique transaction ID which will be used to login and retrieve the digital STP. If the students are using an authorised proxy's email address, the owner of the email address must be aware that his/ her email address will be used for the retrieval of the digital STP.

questions.title: Do I need a Singpass account to retrieve my digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text:
STP holders can still view, download and print their digital STP on the FileSG website, without a Singpass account.
However, we strongly encourage STP holders to register for Singpass, if eligible, for easier retrival of the digital STP from FileSG.

questions.title: How can one verify the authenticity of the digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text:
The digital STP can be verified in two ways:
(1) by using the 'Scan QR Code' function on FileSG website, against the QR code found on the digital STP, or
(2) by uploading the digital STP in OA format onto the FileSG website.

questions.title: How do I retrieve my digital Student's Pass (STP) on FileSG?
questions.text:
For users with a Singpass account:
Login to the FileSG website with your Singpass account
Confirm your contact details if you are logging in for the first time
Upon successful login, you can view and download the STP and files that you have been issued, by different government agencies through FileSG
For users without a Singpass account:
You will need to enter the transaction ID onto the FileSG website, for the file you are trying to retrieve. The transaction ID can be found in the email sent to you, after completion of formalities at ICA, or up to 5 working days after enrolment of biometrics at your Education Institution.
Input the required personal particulars and complete authentication with the One-Time-Password (OTP) sent to the mobile number provided in your STP application.
Upon successful authentication, you can view and download the STP that is associated with the transaction ID provided at the start of this process.

questions.title: How do I view the digital Student's Pass (STP) after downloading it to my device?
questions.text: The digital STP is available for download in two file formats: PDF and OpenAttestation (OA). The PDF version can be downloaded and viewed directly on your personal electronic device (e.g., smartphone, personal computer). The OA version is not meant to be readable but to be shared with a requesting party. The party requesting for the digital STP in OA format will have to upload the shared OA file onto FileSG website, to view the digital STP.

questions.title: How soon will the students receive their digital Student's Pass (STP) after enrolment?
questions.text: For enrolment at ICA Services Centre, students can expect to receive the email notification on retrieval of their digital STP on the same day. For enrolment done at school's campus, students can expect no more than 7 days to receive the email notification on the retrieval of their digital STP.

questions.title: What are the platforms that I can use to retrieve my digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text: Your digital STP can be viewed, downloaded and printed from FileSG, ICA's website (MyICA) and ICA's mobile app (MyICA Mobile). Singpass holders can also view their digital STP on the Singpass app.

questions.title: What if I do not have the transaction ID required to retrieve my digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text:
The transaction ID can be found in the email sent to you by FileSG.
Singpass holders can login to the FileSG website and view their digital Student's Pass (STP) without the transaction ID.
STP holders who are not eligible to register for a Singpass account can contact us via the enquiry form for assistance.

questions.title: What if the student does not have a Singapore mobile number?
questions.text: The student can use the Singapore mobile number of an authorised proxy (e.g., sponsor or parent), so long as the owner of the mobile number is aware that his/ her mobile number is used for the retrieval of the digital Student's Pass.

questions.title: What is OpenAttestation (OA) and when do I download my digital Student's Pass (STP) as OA?
questions.text: OpenAttestation (OA) is an encrypted file format that provides assurance that the document is authentic. The digital LTVP in OA format can only be viewed after it is uploaded at the FileSG website. Download it only when you are required to submit your digital pass in OA format.

questions.title: What is the recommended platform to retrieve and use my digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text:
STP holders can use any platform that best suits their situation and needs to retrieve and use their digital Student's Pass (STP).
As an example, for on-the-spot transactions that require the digital STP to be shown to a person or entity whom the STP holder is transacting with, the STP holder can choose to show the digital STP on the Singpass app if that is more convenient.
If STP holders need to submit a copy of their STP, they can do so by downloading the digital STP from the FileSG website.

questions.title: What should I do if I did not receive the email on retrieving my digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text:
For STP holders who are required to complete formalities at ICA, you should receive the email within 30 minutes after the completion of formalities. If you did not receive the email after 30 minutes:
Check the spam or junk folder of your email account
Ensure that your email inbox folder is not full
Ensure that you have an active internet connection on your device
For STP holders who had their biometrics enrolled at the school, you will receive the email no more than 7 working days from the date of your enrolment.
If you are unable to locate the email after performing the above checks, you may contact us via the enquiry form for assistance.

questions.title: What should I do if there is an error in my particulars on my digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text: You can upload a copy of your digital STP and describe the error via the enquiry form.

questions.title: When must the student have the Singapore mobile number ready?
questions.text: The student will need a Singapore mobile number when he/ she reports to ICA Services Centre for Student's Pass completion of formalities.

questions.title: Why do I see expired digital Student's Passes (STP) issued to me previously, in my FileSG account?
questions.text: Student's Pass (STP) holders will have access to expired copies of their digital STP to complete any transactions that require proof of the STP(s) that they were previously issued with. These expired STPs may be removed over time, at ICA's discretion.

questions.title: Will an unauthorised personnel have access to the data on my digital Student's Pass (STP)?
questions.text: Singpass authentication or Two-Factor Authentication is always required to access your digital Student's Pass (STP). STP holders should ensure that their digital STP is shared only when necessary, and to trusted parties.

questions.title: Will I be issued a physical Student's Pass card if I complete formalities from 27 Feb 2023?
questions.text: ICA has ceased the issuance of physical Student's Pass (STP) cards and has only issued digital STPs since 27 Feb 2023. After the completion of formalities at ICA (if required), or after enrolment of biometrics at the Education Institute that you are studying at, you will receive an email from FileSG, which will provide you with more information on retrieving your digital STP. Singpass holders can also view their digital STP on the Singpass app.

questions.title: Will the digital Student's Pass (STP) be recognised and accepted everywhere?
questions.text: The digital Student's Pass (STP) is equivalent to the physical STP cards that were issued before 27 February 2023.

questions.title: Are Student's Pass holders allowed to work?
questions.text: Student's Pass (STP) holders can refer to MOM’s website for more information on whether you are allowed to work (part-time and/or full-time) while on valid Student's Pass.

questions.title: Can Dependant's Pass (DP) holders study in Singapore?
questions.text:
If you hold a valid Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP), Dependant's Pass (DP) or Immigration Exemption Order (IEO), you are not required to obtain a Student's Pass to pursue full-time, non-religious related studies in Singapore. You may enrol in any full-time, non-religious course within the duration of your existing pass.
If you hold a valid LTVP or DP and wish to study in an approved religious school/madrasah, you will still need to obtain a Student’s Pass. Holders of a valid IEO are exempted from this requirement.

questions.title: Can I change my immigration pass from Dependant's Pass to Student's Pass?
questions.text:
If you are still studying, you should submit a Student's Pass (STP) application for ICA's consideration if you are no longer holding a Dependant's Pass.
To submit an STP application, please approach your school to obtain an STP application number and log in to the STP e-service (using the information provided) to complete the application.

questions.title: Can I clear immigration with a copy of my Student's Pass?
questions.text: You are required to clear immigration with your valid passport and original Student's Pass (STP) card, if a physical STP card was issued to you. Those issued with a digital STP from 27 Feb 23 can furnish their digital STP on their mobile devices, during immigration clearance.

questions.title: Can I continue to hold on to my Student’s Pass if I have stopped my studies?
questions.text: You are required to cancel your Student's Pass (STP) and surrender any physical STP card that was issued to you upon cancellation of the STP.

questions.title: Can I register for marriage while on Student's Pass?
questions.text: The Student's Pass holder can decide whether he/ she wants to get married in Singapore. If you are marrying a Singapore Citizen, you are strongly encouraged to submit a Pre-Marriage Long-Term Visit Pass Assessment (PMLA) for clarity on whether you qualify for a Long-Term Visit Pass in Singapore. You may refer to the ICA website for more information on PMLA.

questions.title: Can I travel out of Singapore after I have received my Student's Pass?
questions.text: A Student’s Pass holder should seek the school's permission if travel takes place during the school term as capturing of students' attendance records is overseen by the school.

questions.title: Can Long Term-Visit Pass (LTVP) holders study in Singapore?
questions.text:
If you hold a valid Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP), Dependant's Pass (DP) or Immigration Exemption Order (IEO), you are not required to obtain a Student's Pass to pursue full-time, non-religious related studies in Singapore. You may enrol in any full-time, non-religious course within the duration of your existing pass.
If you hold a valid LTVP or DP and wish to study in an approved religious school/madrasah, you will still need to obtain a Student’s Pass. Holders of a valid IEO are exempted from this requirement.

questions.title: Do I have to cancel my child’s Student’s Pass after he/she obtains Singapore Permanent Residence?
questions.text: Your child's Student's Pass will be automatically cancelled once he/ she is granted permanent residence.

questions.title: Do I have valid stay in Singapore if my Student’s Pass In-Principle Approval letter is valid?
questions.text:
A valid IPA letter is not an immigration pass that allows you to stay in Singapore. The Immigration & Checkpoints Authority officer will issue you with a visit pass if you are assessed to be eligible for entry into Singapore. Please ensure that you have a valid pass throughout the whole duration of your stay in Singapore. You must complete the formalities for your Student's Pass in order to commence your studies in Singapore.
The period of stay granted is shown either on the visit pass endorsement in your passport or in the electronic Visit Pass (e-Pass) issued to you through email.
You may check the validity of your stay using the visit pass validity tool or the e-Pass Enquiry Portal.

questions.title: Do I need to cancel my Student's Pass if my Leave of Absence is more than 3 months?
questions.text: You must cancel your Student's Pass if you are on Leave of Absence for more than 3 months.

questions.title: Do I need to print out the e-form for Student’s Pass completion of formalities?
questions.text: Please refer to the In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter on the documents required for your completion of formalities for Student's Pass issuance.

questions.title: Do I require a legal guardian before applying for a Student’s Pass?
questions.text: ICA does not impose any requirement for a child to have a legal guardian for the purpose of Student's Pass applications.

questions.title: How can I check if a childcare centre is licensed by the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA)?
questions.text: You may refer to the ECDA website for more information.

questions.title: How can I check my Singapore address that is registered with my Student's Pass?
questions.text: You may view your registered local residential address on the Singpass App (My Profile > Personal) or MyICA online portal (MyProfile) or on the digital Student's Pass downloaded from FileSG (if you are issued with one).

questions.title: How can I submit the documents for my Student's Pass application?
questions.text:
Prospective students of Institute of Higher Learning can upload your documents at the e-Service.
Prospective students of other education institutions or schools can upload your documents after selecting the school type and logging in to this e-Service.

questions.title: How do I cancel my Student’s Pass?
questions.text:
Schools can apply to cancel a Student's Pass (STP) online. You may also submit a cancellation of your STP if you have a Singpass account.
You may refer to Student's Pass cancellation for more information.

questions.title: How do I renew my Student's Pass before pass expiry?
questions.text: You must be accepted for admission into a full-time course by a recognised education institution in Singapore to apply for renewal of your Student's Pass. You may renew your Student's Pass online using the e-Service.

questions.title: How do I sponsor a Student's Pass application?
questions.text:
You must be a Singapore citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident above the age of 21 years old to sponsor a Student's Pass application.
The student must nominate you as his local sponsor in his Student's Pass application at the e-Service for Student's Pass.
You can then login to MyICA or e-Service for Student's Pass using your Singpass to sponsor the Student's Pass application.

questions.title: How do I update my passport detail with Student's Pass IPA status if my passport has expired?
questions.text: You can refer to ICA website for more information on updating your passport details once you have been issued with a Student's Pass.

questions.title: Is my child eligible for Dependant's Pass if I am a Student's Pass holder?
questions.text: There is no Dependant's Pass facility for children of Student's Pass holders.

questions.title: Is there any quota on the number of times I can apply for a Student's Pass?
questions.text: There is no quota for the number of applications you may submit. However, every application submitted will be subject to a non-refundable processing fee of $45.

questions.title: What are the different school types eligible for a Student's Pass?
What are the documents required for Student's Pass Application?
questions.text: You may refer to ICA website on Becoming a Student's Pass Holder and click on the type of school you are applying for to find out more about the documents required. Applicants may be required to provide birth certificate and will be prompted by the e-Service to furnish the necessary documents.

questions.title: What is a Student's Pass?
questions.text: A Student's pass is an immigration pass that allows a foreigner who has been accepted by an educational institution to pursue full-time study in Singapore.

questions.title: What is eForm 16?
questions.text:
eForm 16 refers to Student's Pass application form.
Prospective students of Institute of Higher Learning can retrieve eForm 16 at the e-Service.
Prospective students of other education institutions or schools can retrieve eForm 16 after selecting the school type and logging in to this e-Service.

questions.title: What is the definition of Natural Sibling?
questions.text: Natural sibling refers to a natural brother or sister, a half brother or sister and/or a legally adopted brother or sister.

questions.title: What is the validity of my Student's Pass?
questions.text:
The validity period is shown on your Student's Pass (STP).
Those issued with STP can verify the validity of their STP at https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/ipienquiry/web/verifi/landing.

questions.title: What is the validity of my visit pass after my Student's Pass is cancelled?
questions.text: Upon cancellation of your Student's Pass, a short-term visit pass may be granted, subject to approval. Please check the validity of your short-term visit pass once your Student's Pass is cancelled.

questions.title: What should I do if I wish to transfer from one school to another?
questions.text: You will need to apply for a Student's Pass under the new school, following successful admission.

questions.title: What should I do if my passport is expiring before my Student's Pass validity?
questions.text:
All foreigners must possess a valid travel document at all times while in Singapore. Foreigners who encounter issues on passport matters are to approach their respective embassies for assistance.
Upon issuance of a new travel document, you are to inform ICA on the changes in travel document via our e-Service.

questions.title: What should I do when my Student's Pass expires?
questions.text:
If your Student’s Pass (STP) is about to expire and you are in Singapore, you are advised to depart Singapore before or on the date of expiry of your STP.
However, if you wish to remain in Singapore beyond your STP, you can submit a STP cancellation at least 5 days before the expiry, if you have a valid Singpass account. Alternatively, you can approach your school for STP cancellation. The grant of short-term visit pass is subjected to approval.
Should you be in Singapore after the expiry of your STP without any other valid pass issued to you, you are to report immediately to ICA Services Centre with your passport and expired STP, for assessment and legalisation of your stay.
It is an offence to overstay in Singapore without a valid immigration pass.
If you have left Singapore before the expiry of your Student’s Pass, we do not require any action on your part.

questions.title: When do I cancel my Student's Pass?
questions.text: You must cancel your Student's Pass card if you are no longer studying in your education institution. You may refer to ICA website on Cancellation of Student's Pass for more details.

questions.title: When do I have to leave Singapore after the cancellation of my Student’s Pass?
questions.text:
You may be granted a short-term visit pass to legalise your stay in Singapore upon the cancellation of your Student’s Pass. You should leave Singapore within the validity of the visit pass.
If you require a longer stay, you may apply for an extension of visit pass. Please note that overstaying is an immigration offence in Singapore. If you overstay beyond the validity of your immigration pass, you may be subjected to a composition fine or prosecution in court.

questions.title: When should I apply for a Student’s Pass?
questions.text: The recommended time period for applying for a Student's Pass may vary across the different school types. You may refer to ICA website on Becoming a Student's Pass Holder to select the type of educational institution which you intend to study in, and refer to the processing time under “Procedure”.

questions.title: When will I receive the notification after I submitted the cancellation form to the school?
questions.text: Please check with your school on the status of your Student's Pass cancellation.

questions.title: Where can I access or download V103 and/or other Student’s Pass application related forms?
questions.text:
Prospective students of Institute of Higher Learning can retrieve the relevant application forms at the e-Service.
Prospective students of other education institutions or schools can retrieve the relevant application forms after selecting the school type and logging in to this e-Service.
The relevant form templates are also available for download at https://www.ica.gov.sg/eservicesandforms/all-forms.

questions.title: Where can I check my past Student's Pass details?
questions.text: Information gathered or maintained by ICA is meant for ICA to carry out its function as an immigration authority. We do not provide access to such information.

questions.title: Where can I find the Terms and Conditions of the Student's Pass?
questions.text: You can refer to Terms and Conditions of Student's Pass (STP) for a copy of the form.

questions.title: Where can I surrender my Student’s Pass card?
questions.text:
You may surrender your Student's Pass card to the ICA officer at the departure immigration counter upon your departure at the checkpoints. If you have already departed from Singapore, you may forward your Student's Pass card to the nearest Singapore Overseas Mission or ICA by post/ secured courier, together with a self-explanatory letter, to:
ICA Services Centre
2 Crawford Street,
Singapore 207218

questions.title: Where do I check the expiry date of my Student's Pass?
questions.text: The expiry date is shown on your physical Student's Pass card or digital Student's Pass (issued from 27 Feb 2023).

questions.title: Who can certify a true copy of supporting documents for my Student's Pass application?
questions.text:
The authorised personnel from your school that issued the educational certificates and result transcripts can certify the photocopies of the mentioned documents. The authorised personnel from the school should sign on the certified copy and endorse the school's stamp on the certified copies.
You may be required to produce the original copies of the certified educational certificates and result transcripts at the time of collection of the Student's Pass.

questions.title: Why are only children enrolled in childcare centres licensed by Early Childhood and Development Agency (ECDA) eligible for a Student's Pass?
questions.text: Early Childhood Development Centres or ECDCs (commonly referred to as infant/childcare centres or kindergartens), are required to obtain a licence under the Early Childhood Development Centres Act and Regulations before commencing operations.
