questions.title: What if there is a change in the Tenant’s business constitution e.g. change in partner(s) or shareholder(s) etc.?
questions.text:
Q1 : Is submission of this update necessary?
Yes, if the existing Tenant’s name has been changed with Accounting & Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA).
Q2 : What are the restrictions/conditions?
There shall not be changes in the Tenant’s business constitution including but not limited to:
(a) Unique Entity Number (UEN) i.e. Business Registration Number
(b) Shareholding (where applicable)
(c) Mode of Business
(d) Partnership structure where the Tenant is a partnership or a limited liability partnership.
Q3 : What is the supporting document required for this update?
Up-to-date business registration record from ACRA showing the new name.
Q4 : When will my update be processed?
Your update will be processed upon the successful verification of your supporting document against HDB’s record.
Q5 : Is there an administrative fee payable for this update? How long is the validity of the update, if approved?
No administrative fee is payable for the update. The one-time approval is valid without expiration.
Q6 : Who can I contact for further details?
If you wish to get in touch with HDB, please visit our ‘Contact Us’ page.
Q7 : How do I make this update?
(a) Process
Complete an online update form by clicking on the words "UPDATE OF COMPANY’S NAME" below.
Attach the up-to-date business registration record from Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) in scanned document or digital image in pdf or jpg format in the online update form.
(b) Payment
No payment is required.
Q8 : What if there is a change in the Tenant’s business constitution e.g. change in partner(s) or shareholder(s) etc.?
A change in sole-proprietor, partners or shareholders is deemed as a change in business constitution of the Tenant. However, please note that the Sole Proprietor/ Partner(s) / Shareholder(s) as at the commencement of tenancy or their next-of-kin must retain at least 51% of the shares in the Tenant upon the change in business constitution, otherwise it will be deemed as an assignment of tenancy. For such cases, you are required to submit an Application for Tenancy Change using GoBusiness Licensing.
With effect from 16 Oct 2013, new commercial tenancies let out via tender or assignment will not be allowed for assignment throughout their tenancies. Only tenants who have been with HDB for at least 15 years as of 16 Oct 2013 are permitted till 15 Oct 2019 to assign their premises.
For any further clarification, you may contact the Commercial Properties General Enquiry Line at 6866-3073 or write to us.

questions.title: How do I know if my request has been successful if my device hangs before the acknowledgement page?
questions.text: If your device hangs before you reach the acknowledgement page, your request has not been successful. Please submit a new request later.
topics: Cancel auto renewal of season parking by giro

questions.title: Why I am not eligible to purchase season parking at the preferred car park(s)?
questions.text: HDB car parks are provided primarily to serve the parking needs of HDB's residents. At car parks with high parking demand, HDB needs to prioritise parking allocation for a fair distribution of parking lots among residents. You may refer to the monthly season parking charges for the various priority groups and corresponding booking dates for low occupancy and high occupancy rate car parks. Successful allocation is subject to the availability of parking lots at the designated car park at the point of purchase.

questions.title: Is there an administrative fee for an update of IU number?
questions.text:
Q1: Why can't I update my IU/ OBU number?
There is a limit to the number of updates that can be done. You can only update your IU/ OBU number once in 30 days. You may have exceeded the limit.
Q2: Why is there a need to key on a 10-digit IU number and where can I find it?
The IU number is required for car parks implemented with the Electronic Parking System. The 10-digit IU number is located on the left-hand side of your IU.
Q3: Is there an administrative fee for an update of IU number?
There is no charge imposed.
topics: Change vehicle iu obu number for season parking

questions.title: How do I find out if I am eligible to purchase season parking for car park(s) located in/ near Central Business District or Restricted Zone?
questions.text: Car parks located in/ near Central Business District or Restricted Zone are subjected to eligibility and availability. You can view available season parking lots for more information.

questions.title: Do I have to apply for a new season parking if my last season parking was purchased within 3 months?
questions.text: If your last season parking was purchased within 3 months and there is no termination done, you do not need to apply for a new season parking if you are applying for the same vehicle and car park group. Please renew your season parking instead.

questions.title: I have reminded the flat owner, and he has informed me that he has obtained HDB’s approval to rent out his flat/ bedroom to me. When will I be able to check that I am an authorised tenant through this service?
questions.text:
The tenant’s information will be updated in our system within 2 days from the date of approval
of the rental.

questions.title: My company rented the flat/ bedroom from the flat owner. Will I be able to use this service to check if I am an authorised tenant?
questions.text:
Yes, you can use this service to enquire if you are an authorised tenant, even though the flat is
rented by your company, as the flat owner is required to provide particulars of the tenants staying in the flat.

questions.title: I am renting a flat/ bedroom from a flat owner. However, the result of the service enquiry shows that I am not an authorised tenant. Why is this so? What should I do?
questions.text:
The possible reasons are:
The flat owner has not obtained HDB’s approval to rent out his flat/ bedroom with HDB;
The previous rental approval has expired; or
The flat owner did not register you as a tenant.
Please remind the flat owner to apply for HDB’s approval for renting out of flat/ bedroom with HDB. If
there is an existing rental approval, please remind the flat owner to update tenant details to register you as a
tenant.

questions.title: My landlord did not register me as an authorised tenant, despite many reminders. What should I do?
questions.text:
If you are renting the whole flat, before moving into the flat, you should ensure that the flat
owner has HDB’s approval to rent out the flat/ bedroom to you. You can ask the flat owner to show you a
copy of HDB’s approval letter.
Before signing any rental agreement with the flat owner, you are advised to read the rental agreement terms carefully
and ensure that you understand and agree with the terms. To protect your interest, you may also include a clause in
the rental agreement that the contract is valid only if the flat owner obtains HDB’s approval to rent
out the whole flat/ bedroom with HDB.
If you have concerns about the flat owner’s eligibility to rent out his flat/ bedroom to you, you may consider
terminating the rental agreement, in accordance with the terms. As the rental agreement is a private arrangement
between you and the flat owner, HDB is not in a position to mediate if there is a dispute on matters regarding the
rental agreement.

questions.title: Can I not change my waste pipe(s) under HIP as I have replaced them recently?
questions.text: Yes, but please note that if ceiling leakage occurs at the flat below yours subsequently and it is caused by your renovation contractor's method of replacing your waste pipe(s), you will have to rectify the leaking waste pipe(s) at your own cost to stop the ceiling leakage.

questions.title: My landlord did not register me as an authorised tenant, and he refused to refund the rental deposit that I have paid, upon termination of the rental agreement. Can HDB mediate?
questions.text:
Matters relating to the rental agreement, such as rental amount, payment or forfeiture of deposit
and right to terminate the agreement, are private matters between you and the flat owner. HDB is not in a position
to mediate if there is a dispute on these matters.

questions.title: How much do I have to pay for HIP?
questions.text: The amount will be based on the Optional Improvements you have opted for. This will be indicated before the poll.

questions.title: My landlord has rented out the flat without obtaining HDB’s approval, and I will be moving out of the flat. How do I report the unauthorised rental to HDB?
questions.text:
You may write to us to report any suspected
unauthorised rental or misuse of the flat. All information provided will be kept confidential.

questions.title: What are the payment terms for HIP?
questions.text: You can pay for the cost of HIP in one lump sum or by monthly instalment, using cash or your CPF savings.

questions.title: How long does it take for my application to be approved?
questions.text:
A1: For digital applications, it will be processed within a day. For hardcopy applications, it will take 4 to 6 weeks for HDB and the banks to process.
Q2: When will deduction commence?
A2: The first deduction will be made on the 18th of the month for the current month’s season parking. If the first deduction is unsuccessful, a second deduction will be made on the 26th of the same month. HDB will inform you of the commencement date of the GIRO deductions once your bank approves the application.
Example: For August 2025 season parking, the first deduction attempt will be on 18 August 2025.
If the first attempt fails (e.g., insufficient funds), a second attempt will be made on 26 August 2025.
Q3: Where can I find the Business Reply Service?
A3: Please print the form double-sided as the Business Reply Service is located on the back of the application form.
topics: Manage auto renewal of season parking by giro

questions.title: Do I have to pay GST for my share of the HIP cost?
questions.text: Yes, you need to pay the prevailing GST.

questions.title: When do I start paying for my share of the HIP cost?
questions.text: You will start paying your share of the HIP cost after the works are completed.

questions.title: Why do I see the message “You have exceeded the maximum number of attempts for the same FIN/ NRIC No.”?
questions.text:
The system limits the maximum number of enquiries you can make on a particular FIN/ NRIC number to 3
enquiries. You may check again the next day.
topics: Check authorised tenants of flat / Problems with accessing the e-Service

questions.title: I would like to speak to a Customer Service Executive before proceeding with the application. What should I do?
questions.text:
Q1: What is this e-Service for?
You can apply to pay your upgrading cost in full from your CPF Ordinary Account.
Q2: Under what conditions can I submit an application?
You can submit an application if:
- No legal action has been initiated for the outstanding instalment
- There is no estate action or finance action for the flat
- There is sufficient balance in your CPF Ordinary Account
Q3: How would I be notified on the status of my application?
You may view the application status of your upgrading cost payments using the e-Service.
Q4: My application has been unsuccessful. What should I do?
The approval of the application is subject to CPF Board’s prevailing policies. You may contact contact CPF Board regarding your application.
Q5: Am I allowed to submit more than 1 application?
You are allowed to only submit one application per NRIC at any 1 time.
Q6: How long does it take for CPF Board to process each application?
In general, CPF Board requires about 3 to 6 working days to process each application.
Q7: How much of my CPF monies can I use to pay for my full payment of upgrading cost?
You would be able to use monies from your CPF Ordinary Account to pay for full payment of upgrading cost. You can check your CPF Ordinary Account balance online through CPF Board’s website via 'my cpf Online Services'.
Q8: Are there any fees/ charges for the use of this e-Service?
There are no fees/ charges imposed for the use of this e-Service.
Q9: I would like to speak to a Customer Service Executive before proceeding with the application. What should I do?
If you have any questions, you may contact us or make an appointment with our HDB Branch.

questions.title: Why am I allowed to key in any unit no. for the block, even if the unit no. does not exist?
questions.text:
You are required to provide the person’s FIN/ NRIC number, date of birth, and address of the flat correctly before the system reveals whether
the person is a registered tenant allowed to stay in the flat. Hence, the system does not make sure that the unit
no. you have keyed in is a valid one.
topics: Check authorised tenants of flat / Problems with accessing the e-Service

questions.title: How do I carry out improvements that do not fall within the Home Improvement Programme (HIP)?
questions.text: Approach your Working Committee so that it can collate a list of commonly requested improvements and liaise with the contractor on your behalf. You need to make full payment for these items directly to the contractor.

questions.title: Can I opt out of all the Optional Improvements under the Home Improvement Programme (HIP)? If yes, do I still have to pay anything?
questions.text: Yes, you may opt out of all the Optional Improvements and will not be required to pay anything for them.

questions.title: When do I decide on the HIP Optional Improvements and select the materials? What is the deadline?
questions.text: Once you have polled, you may opt out of the Optional Improvements you do not want. An Information Centre will be set up and full mock-ups of the toilets/bathrooms will also be set up, with the actual materials offered. You will be invited (by letter) to view the mock-ups and samples of the main entrance doors and gates, and to make your decisions on the Optional Improvements and materials within the opting period. This period, with the start and close dates, will be stated (in the letter). After the opting period, changes are not allowed.

questions.title: The transaction is stuck at the eNETS page after I have provided my credit card details for payment. How can I confirm if my payment is successful?
questions.text: You will receive an email acknowledgement if the payment is successful. Alternatively, you may also access this e-Service again to check if there is any outstanding payment for the notice.
topics: Pay parking fines via vehicle notice reference number

questions.title: Can I still change my decisions on the HIP Optional Improvements after the opting period?
questions.text: Generally, changes after the opting period are not allowed. This is to facilitate construction and avoid abortive cost. However, if there are valid reasons, like you were overseas during the opting period, you will have another two weeks to let us know your decisions on the Optional Improvements.

questions.title: Why is my outstanding parking offence notice(s) not displayed for payment?
questions.text: Only notice(s) payable online will be displayed.

questions.title: Do I need to have a water test done in order to opt out of toilet upgrading under HIP? How much do I pay for it?
questions.text: If you are opting out of toilet upgrading, your toilets have to pass a water test to ensure that there is no ceiling leakage at the flat below yours. You do not need to pay for the water test.

questions.title: What does the water test (to opt out of toilet upgrading under HIP) entail?
questions.text: The floor outlet of the toilet is blocked off temporarily with a water plug. The floor is flooded with water to about 10 mm deep for 4 hours. The underside of the floor slab and the base of the adjacent walls are then checked for signs of leakage.

questions.title: If I have renovated my toilets/bathrooms recently but they fail the water test in HIP, can I rectify only the ceiling leakage without touching the other parts of my toilets/bathrooms?
questions.text: Yes, but please note that effective rectification involves removing the bottom two courses of the wall tiles and the entire floor tiles. This is to enable us to apply the waterproofing membrane to the entire floor and the bottom 100 - 200 mm portion of the walls. This is followed by re-tiling to match the surrounding finishes. Please also note that you will still have to pay the full share of the cost of the toilet upgrading package. Alternatively, you may engage your own contractor to rectify the ceiling leakage and pay him the full rectification cost.

questions.title: Why is my outstanding Parking Offence Notice(s) not displayed for payment?
questions.text: Only notice(s) payable online will be displayed.
topics: Pay parking fines via vehicle notice reference number

questions.title: If the water test (to opt out of toilet upgrading under HIP) fails, will I get additional time to select the materials?
questions.text: Yes, an additional two weeks will be given for you to select the materials.

questions.title: Can I opt out of the Essential Improvements under the HIP?
questions.text: No. You cannot opt out of the Essential Improvements because these are necessary for public health and safety. Nevertheless, the works will only be done where applicable.

questions.title: I just did a permanent transfer of season parking to another vehicle recently. Why can't I do another transfer?
questions.text: A permanent transfer of season parking to another vehicle can only be done once in 30 days as it is meant to be a long-term change. For a short-term change, please temporarily transfer your season parking to another vehicle.
topics: Permanently transfer season parking to another vehicle

questions.title: Why can’t I select a specific date for renewal?
questions.text:
Renewal is on a calendar month basis. A full month’s rate will be charged regardless of the commencement date.
Q2: What happens if I renew late?
A2: If you have not renewed your season parking for the month, you will be charged for short-term parking and cannot park your vehicle in lots reserved for season parking holders. Any short-term parking charges paid will not be refunded.
Q3: Why can’t I renew for a month even though I can select it?
A3: You already have an existing season parking for that month. Please select another month for renewal.
Q4: What is the maximum period I can renew my season parking for?
A4: You can renew your season parking for up to 12 months, subject to your eligibility and the availability of parking lots.
Q5: How do I know what priority I have been accorded?
A5: Please refer to order of priority for allocation of parking lots for more details.

questions.title: How do I update my mobile number and email address?
questions.text: You can update your mobile number and email address, at both MyHDB Page and Singpass.
topics: Permanently transfer season parking to another vehicle

questions.title: I just did a permanent transfer of season parking to another car park recently. Why can't I do another transfer?
questions.text:
A permanent transfer of season parking to another car park can only be done once in 30 days as it is meant to be a long-term change. For a short-term change, please temporarily transfer your season parking to another car park.
Q2: Why is there a need to key in a 10-digit In-Vehicle Unit (IU) number?
A2: The IU number is required for car parks implemented with the Electronic Parking System. The 10-digit IU number is located on the left hand side of your In-Vehicle Unit.
Q3: How do I update my mobile number and email address?
A3: You can update your mobile number and email address, at both MyHDB Page and Singpass.
Q4: Why do I have to top-up for a change in car park?
A4: Different car parks may charge different rates. Please refer to the table under Monthly Season Parking Charges for the relevant rates charged for different car park types.
Q5: Why is my car park not detected when I key in the postal code/ address of my car park?
A5: Please search using an HDB residential address.
Q6: Why can’t I change my In-Vehicle Unit Number when changing car park?
A6: A change in car park should not require a change in In-Vehicle Unit number as there is no change in vehicle. Please change your vehicle IU number for season parking.
topics: Permanently transfer season parking to another car park

questions.title: Why did I encounter the error message "Please fill in a valid notice number"?
questions.text: This e-Service is only applicable for notices issued by Housing & Development Board (HDB). Please also check that the notice number is entered correctly.

questions.title: How do I know my appeal is submitted successfully?
questions.text: You will receive an email acknowledgement if the appeal is submitted successfully.

questions.title: Do I need to pay for the parking fine if I have not received the outcome of my appeal and the payment is due?
questions.text: You can withhold payment for the notice until you receive our reply.

questions.title: Can I submit an appeal for multiple parking notices?
questions.text: No, please submit a separate appeal for each parking offence notice.

questions.title: Why is there a need for the payment gateway to deduct a $1 fee from my credit limit when I update to another credit card?
questions.text: For the purpose of authenticating the registration, a $1 transaction authentication will be performed. However, the $1 charge will not be reflected on your credit card statement, and it will automatically be reinstated back to your credit limit within 7-14 days, depending on your issuing bank.
topics: Update credit card information for auto renewal of season parking

questions.title: How would I know if the update of credit card information is successful?
questions.text:
You will see an acknowledgement page if the update of credit card information is successful. If you have provided us with an email address during the application, you will also receive a system generated email acknowledging the update of credit card information and informing you of the commencement date for the billing transaction under the new credit card account.
Q4: How do I know whether my application has been successful if the computer hangs?
If your computer hangs before you reach the acknowledgement page, your transaction has not been successful. You may wish to try again later or contact your card issuing bank for assistance.
topics: Update credit card information for auto renewal of season parking

questions.title: Why can't my car park be found?
questions.text: The first two alphabetical letters on the car park signboard refer to the managing branch. For the car park number, please do not key in the first two alphabetical letters. For example, for car park TPTP52 (as shown on the car park signboard), the car park number is TP52.

questions.title: Who can use e-Resale system to submit Resale Application and/or Request for Value?
questions.text:
e-Resale system can be used by:
(i) salespersons engaged by the buyers or sellers to submit resale
application
(ii) salespersons engaged by the buyers to submit Request for Value.

questions.title: What should I do when I see errors while logging in via Singpass?
questions.text: Please refer to AskGov for questions related to Singpass errors.

questions.title: While I was in the midst of submitting my resale application/ Request for Value, I encountered an "Inactive Time Out" prompt. What should I do?
questions.text:
If you do not complete the submission of your Resale Application or Request for Value within a certain time
frame, the system will prompt you to confirm whether you wish to continue with the transaction.

questions.title: To submit Resale Application or Request for Value via the e-Resale system, what information do I need to log on?
questions.text: You will need to key in your NRIC number and your Singpass password.

questions.title: Why must I provide the driver’s particulars when I submit an appeal against a parking offence notice?
questions.text: Reminder notices will be sent to the driver for settlement if the appeal is not successful.

questions.title: Why is the maximum validity of a temporary transfer only 31 days?
questions.text: A temporary transfer of season parking is for short-term change. For a long-term change, please permanently transfer your season parking to another car park.
topics: Temporarily transfer season parking to another car park
Temporarily transfer season parking to another vehicle

questions.title: What happens when my temporary transfer expires?
questions.text: The season parking will revert back to your original car park that you transferred from.
topics: Temporarily transfer season parking to another car park

questions.title: Why can’t I terminate my season parking?
questions.text:
First-time purchasers can apply season parking for the current month with full rate or buy a longer-term season parking with pro-rated charge for the current month plus full rate for following month. As season parking is for long-term use, termination and refund of the pro-rated season parking (i.e. current month and subsequent month) is not allowed.
For example, if you purchase season parking from 13 March to 31 May, you will not be allowed to terminate your season parking from 13 March to 30 April. You can however, terminate your season parking from 1 May to 31 May on 30 April,and the unused season parking from 1 May to 31 May will be refunded.

questions.title: How do I know whether my application has been successful if the computer hangs?
questions.text:
Q1: I have updated my credit card information but my deduction was unsuccessful. What should I do?
You may renew your season parking via e-Service, MyHDB mobile app or AXS and Cash Payment Kiosks self-service kiosks. On the 18th of the next month, deduction will resume if you have a valid season parking.
topics: Update credit card information for auto renewal of season parking

questions.title: How much refund will I get?
questions.text:
The amount of season parking charges to be refunded will be calculated from the day after the request to terminate your season parking was made.
For example, if you are terminating your season parking on the 1st of the month, the refund will be computed from the 2nd till the expiry date of the season parking.

questions.title: The buyers have exercised the Option to Purchase on 1 January 2025. Both buyers and sellers have agreed to submit the resale application within 30 days under Clause 12 of the Option to Purchase. When must buyers and sellers submit the resale application?
questions.text:
For the resale application to be registered with HDB, the second party must submit his portion of the
application within 7 days after the first party has submitted his. The time period indicated under Clause
12 of the Option to Purchase is a contractual agreement between both parties, and can be extended or expedited
with mutual consent.

questions.title: If I add a unit to my watchlist, does it mean that the unit has been reserved for me?
questions.text: No. The ‘Add Flats to Watchlist’ e-Service is meant to help you monitor the availability of flats you are interested in. However, whether you can book a particular unit on your watchlist will depend on whether the unit is still available for your ethnic group at the time of your flat booking appointment.
topics: Flat Listing / Buy a flat from HDB

questions.title: Are the interest rates on the financial institutions’ loan packages in this e-Service available to me?
questions.text: The interest rates of the loan packages are indicative for the purpose of estimating the loan amount. Please apply for an In-Principle Approval from the participating FIs for a housing loan. You may also contact any FIs directly for more information on their housing loan packages and application details.
topics: Loan Listing And Financial Calculators / Financial calculators

questions.title: I have been invited to book a flat. How would I know when a flat on my watchlist has been taken up?
questions.text: You will receive an email notification when a flat on your watchlist has been taken up. You can change the frequency of these notifications by accessing the ‘Add Flats to Watchlist’ e-service on the HDB Flat Portal and using the “Notification settings”.
topics: Flat Listing / Buy a flat from HDB

questions.title: Does this e-Service confirm the amount of CPF housing grant and/or housing loan I am eligible for?
questions.text:
If you do not have a valid HFE letter, the amount of CPF housing grant and/or HDB housing loan in this e-Service will merely be indicative according to what you have provided to the calculator.
If you wish to confirm the amount of housing grants and/or HDB housing loan that you are eligible for, or apply for an In-Principle Approval from the participating financial institutions for a housing loan, please apply for an HFE letter.
Find out more about the HFE letter.
topics: Loan Listing And Financial Calculators / Financial calculators

questions.title: Does this e-Service confirm the cash proceeds that I will receive after selling my flat?
questions.text: No. You have provided to the calculator the resale price of your flat, the outstanding housing loan amount and/or CPF refund amount, to work out the cash proceeds after selling your flat. The cash proceeds amount is merely an estimate based on what you have provided to the calculator.
topics: Loan Listing And Financial Calculators / Financial calculators

questions.title: Are the interest rates on the FI’s loan packages in this e-Service available to me?
questions.text: The interest rates of the loan packages are indicative for the purpose of estimating the loan amount. Please apply for an In-Principal Approval from the participating FIs for a housing loan. You may also contact any FIs directly for more information on their housing loan packages and application details.
topics: Loan Listing And Financial Calculators / Financial calculators

questions.title: How are the flats offered by HDB organised on the portal?
questions.text: Build-To-Order (BTO) flats are grouped by town/estate and project name. Balance flats are grouped by town/estate and street name.
topics: Flat Listing / Buy a flat from HDB

questions.title: I am only interested in flats in a particular estate. How do I find them?
questions.text:
You may use the filters provided on the portal to help you search for the available flats by location, price or other criteria.
By clicking on ‘More Filters’, you can rank the filters according to your preference.
topics: Flat Listing / Buy a flat from HDB

questions.title: I have submitted a Request for Value. Where can I check the status of the request?
questions.text:
The buyer can check the status of the request via the HDB Flat Portal >> My Flat Dashboard. He will have
to log in using his NRIC number and Singpass.

questions.title: Can I opt out from CareShield Life?
questions.text:
I am a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident born in 1980 or later
CareShield Life is universal and mandatory for Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents born in 1980 or later. You will not be able to opt out.
CareShield Life is a long-term care insurance that provides basic financial support should an insured develop severe disability. CareShield Life will provide you with better protection and assurance for basic long-term care needs with:
Lifetime cash payouts, for as long as the insured is unable to do three or more Activities of Daily Living (ADLs);
Increasing monthly payouts, at $689/month in 2026 and increases annually until age 67 or when a successful claim is made, whichever is earlier;
Government subsidies to make it affordable, with no one losing coverage if they cannot pay premiums;
Premiums can be fully paid by MediSave.
I am a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident born in 1979 or earlier
Singapore Citizen and Permanent Resident born between 1970 and 1979, who were covered under the ElderShield 400 scheme and did not develop severe disability, were auto-enrolled to CareShield Life from 1 December 2021. You will not be able to opt out of CareShield Life as the deadline to opt out was 31 December 2023. Find out how CareShield Life protects you for life.
If you were not auto-enrolled and had chosen to join CareShield Life, please note that you will not be able to opt out from CareShield Life after the 60-day free-look period.
CareShield Life is also mandatory for foreigners who become Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents from 1 October 2020 onwards and are born in 1979 or earlier, provided they do not have severe disability (if granted residency status from 1 October 2020 to 31 December 2025) or any disability (if granted residency status from 1 January 2026 onwards).
If you wish to opt out of CareShield Life, you can submit an appeal via Opt-out of CareShield Life e-Service (Singpass login required). Please note that all appeals undergo a rigorous assessment process, and only those with substantiated grounds will be considered.
If you would like to find out the premiums payable, you can log in to your Healthcare dashboard to view your projected premiums. There are several options available to pay your CareShield Life premiums, including through GIRO or having a family member take over the payment.
Government subsidies are also available to ensure that no one loses coverage due to an inability to pay. Find out more about your payment options.

questions.title: Why is there a need for the payment gateway to deduct a $1 fee from my credit limit when I register for auto renewal of season parking by credit card?
questions.text: For the purpose of authenticating the registration, a $1 transaction authentication will be performed. However, the $1 charge will not be reflected on your credit card statement, and it will automatically be reinstated back to your credit limit within 7-14 days, depending on your issuing bank.
topics: Apply for auto renewal of season parking by credit card

questions.title: Why is the application not available in hardcopy forms?
questions.text: For our customers’ convenience and as part of our green initiative towards paperless operations, the application is made available electronically via e-Service. Customers may submit the application anytime at their convenience.
topics: Apply for auto renewal of season parking by credit card

questions.title: Can I have a receipt for the payment of the season parking via this payment mode?
questions.text: The relevant entries in your credit card statement will be recognised as evidence of your payments. Hence, no further payment notices or official receipts will be issued. Alternatively, you may view season parking transaction history to check the validity of your season parking.
topics: Apply for auto renewal of season parking by credit card

questions.title: How would I know if my application is successful?
questions.text: Upon submission of the application online, you will receive a real-time acknowledgement of the application status (successful/ unsuccessful). If you have provided us with an email address during the application, you will also receive a system generated email acknowledging your application and informing you of the first billing transaction date.
topics: Apply for auto renewal of season parking by credit card

questions.title: How do I revoke the authorisation for the use of MediSave savings for my own and/or family member(s)' medical expenses?
questions.text:
The steps to revoke your authorisation for the use of MediSave savings for your own and/or family member(s)’ medical expenses depend on the type of Medical Claims Authorisation Form (MCAF) that you had previously signed:
If you signed the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (Single Institution) [MCAF(S)]
Please approach the Medical Institution where you signed the form to revoke your authorisation.
If you signed the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (Multiple Institutions) [MCAF(M)]
You may obtain a copy of the revocation form from any Public Healthcare Institution. Alternatively, you may download the revocation form and email the completed form to mohh.mcaf@mohh.com.sg.
Important:
Revoking your MCAF(M) authorisation revokes only the authorisation provided under the MCAF(M). Any MCAF(S) authorisations separately provided to individual Medical Institutions will remain valid and must be revoked directly with the respective Medical Institution(s).

questions.title: What happens to my saved details from the previous version of the Retirement Payout Planner?
questions.text: Your saved details from the previous Retirement Payout Planner are automatically carried over to the enhanced planner, so you do not need to re-enter your information. You can go directly into any feature and continue your retirement planning from where you left off.
topics: PLAN with CPF / Retirement Payout Planner
Retirement Income / Retirement Income Planning Tools and Services

questions.title: What's new in the Retirement Payout Planner?
questions.text:
The Retirement Payout Planner has been enhanced with three new features to help you plan your retirement more easily:

questions.title: What information from the Record of Payment (eROP) is required to complete the application for refund and adjustment of contributions paid?
questions.text: To complete your application for refund and adjustment of contributions paid, you will need to extract key details from Record of Payment (eROP), such as the Submission ID, Payment received on, and the Month paid for. Please refer to the attached instruction on where to locate these details in the eROP.

questions.title: Why does the excess CPF from the Additional Wage ceiling calculator differ from the automatic refund, and how do I calculate my employee's share?
questions.text:
The Additional Wage (AW) ceiling calculator computes excess CPF on wages above the AW ceiling, while the automatic refund only covers excess contributions above the Annual Limit ($37,740).
This means:
Employees below 55 years old with full contribution rates (37%) will typically see no difference between the two figures.
Employees with lower contribution rates (e.g. those above 55 or 1st/2nd year SPRs) may have excess contributions above the AW ceiling that fall below the Annual Limit. Employers shall apply for a refund to rectify such overpayments.
A few dollar difference may still arise as the AW ceiling calculator computes CPF contributions payable on Total Wages by rounding to the nearest dollar at the monthly level, while the automatic refund is computed based on total CPF contributions paid at the annual level.
To calculate the employee's share of the automatic refund, use the following formula:
Employee's share = (Total excess CPF refunded ÷ Total CPF contribution rate) × Employee's share of CPF contribution rate
Example:
Employee is a 58-year-old Singapore Citizen with $40,000 total CPF contributions for 2025.
Calculate total excess refunded:
Total excess = Total paid - Annual Limit
= $40,000 - $37,740
= $2,260
Calculate employee’s share:
Employee’s share = ($2,260 ÷ 32.5%1) × 17%1
= $1,182 (cents should be dropped)
1 Applicable for Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident (3rd year onwards) aged 55-60. Refer to past CPF contribution rates.

questions.title: Can I access the Retirement Payout Planner on behalf of my spouse or family member?
questions.text: The Retirement Payout Planner is personalised to each member, so each member will need to log in with their own Singpass to access the planner. If you would like to help your spouse or family member plan for their retirement, you can guide them through the planner while they are logged in to their own Singpass account.

questions.title: What are the different features found in the Retirement Payout Planner?
questions.text:
The Retirement Payout Planner is organised into three features.
“Your Options” suggests personalised actions to help you reach your retirement payout goal. You can access this feature once you have completed both “Your Projection” and “Your Goal”.
“Your Projection” allows you to project your monthly retirement payouts based on your preferred payout start age and CPF LIFE plan.
After saving your projection, you will be able to simulate the impact of actions such as CPF top-ups, withdrawals and Ordinary Account (OA) reservation on your projected payouts, where applicable to you.
“Your Goal” allows you to set your retirement payout goal. You can set your own goal or use the retirement payout guide, a short questionnaire, to estimate how much you’ll need every month to support your desired retirement lifestyle.

questions.title: I would like to rectify the contributions paid to my employees. Which action should I select in the application?
questions.text:
For rectification to the contributions paid to your employees, please select the action that is most applicable to you based on the scenarios listed in the table below:
Scenarios
Action (Select whichever applicable)
You overlooked the age group or citizenship status of your employee(s) and used the wrong contribution rates.
You paid CPF contributions for employee(s) who have left the company.
You paid CPF contributions on a conditional wage which your employee(s) have to repay due to not fulfilling certain conditions tied to the payment.
You paid CPF contributions on paid annual leave which was later converted to no pay leave due to your employee(s) resigning/being terminated or taking an extended no pay leave period.
You estimated the annual AW ceiling and paid CPF contributions based on your employee’s estimated AW Ceiling during the year.
There were changes to the employees’ Ordinary Wages which resulted in changes in the AW ceiling.
Refund of contributions paid:
Single employee or platform worker
Multiple employees or platform workers (within single submission only)
You have made two CPF submissions for the same month.
Refund of contributions paid:
Entire submission
You have selected the wrong contributions month and year during CPF submission.
Adjustment of submission details
Month paid for (all entries)
You have paid CPF contributions for your new employee before their commencement with the company.
Adjustment of submission details
Month paid for (selected entries only)
You have submitted using the wrong CPF Submission Number (CSN).
Adjustment of submission details
CPF Submission Number (all entries)
You have paid CPF contributions for an employee who has been transferred to another CSN.
You have overlooked that your employee has been seconded overseas and paid his Voluntary Contributions (VC) under Mandatory Contributions (MC) CSN.
Adjustment of submission details
CPF Submission Number (selected entries only)
You have paid CPF contributions for your employee using NRIC that does not belong to him.
You have paid CPF contributions for the wrong employee.
Adjustment of submission details
Payment recipients

questions.title: What is the “Your Options” feature in the Retirement Payout Planner and how does it work?
questions.text:
The new “Your Options” feature in the Retirement Payout Planner suggests options on the actions you can consider (e.g. top-ups to your CPF retirement savings), personalised based on your projected payouts and retirement payout goal. You can access this feature once you have completed both “Your Projection” and “Your Goal”.
As with any financial decision, do consider your personal financial situation before committing to any action. The suggestions are meant to serve as a guide for your consideration, and you are not obligated to act on them.
